sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 3.2.2023 in connection with Crime No.8/2023 registered at Police Station Mehendwani,
District Dindori (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n) and 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 and 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young man aged 19 years and prosecutrix is aged 15 years and 2 months.
Applicant and prosecutrix were in love relation.
It is submitted that applicant has falsely been implicated in the case.

sentences.text: In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted that applicant is said to have eloped with prosecutrix and committed rape on her.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

5 . Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the age of applicant and the fact that investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

7. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
